definitions: The leader of the Decepticons in the Transformers franchise, often depicted as the arch-enemy of Optimus Prime.
A fictional character, a robot capable of transforming into various forms, typically a Walther P38 pistol or a tank.
examples: Megatron commanded his forces to attack.
The battle between Optimus Prime and Megatron was legendary.
Megatron's alternate mode was a powerful tank.
